description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sippikulama, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830111
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their ownership status, extent, and possession details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
